title: Efficacy and Biocompatibility of Jason® Collagen Fleece for Haemostasis after Iliac Crest Harvesting of Autologous Cancellous Bone – An Observationional Clinical Study. Fleege C., Schmidt J., Schmidt I
authors: Zukowski D. and. Rauschmann M, Touch Medical Media 2012. * Jason® fleece
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Jason® fleece is equally effective and safe as Lyostypt and Hemocol, and offers significantly better handling comfort. 06/2026” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
